steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Nutrient Cycles: Materials such as carbon and water are constantly recycled through the living and non-living parts of ecosystems. Decomposers play a vital role in breaking down dead material and returning nutrients to the soil.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Describe the carbon cycle, explaining how carbon is added to and removed from the atmosphere. | Describe the main processes in the water cycle. | Explain three factors that affect the rate of decomposition.
